items.title: GameStop Stock (GME) Has 4 Reasons to Rally Beyond Its Meme-Stock Fame
items.summary: GameStop (GME), Wall Street’s most famous meme stock, is giving investors more reasons to take its fundamentals seriously. The stock has gained more than 30% in 2026, and it’s not just speculation. The retailer saw its operating profit jump 141% last quarter, even as sales fell nearly 19%. Under Ryan Cohen’s direction, GameStop accumulated a nearly $5 billion stake in eBay (EBAY), while Cohen personally bought about $119 million worth of GameStop stock this year. items.title: BMO highlights top interactive entertainment pick
items.summary: Investing.com -- BMO has reiterated its Outperform rating and Top Pick designation on Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ: TTWO), maintaining a $285 price target, after the company announced record-breaking launch results for Grand Theft Auto VI.

items.title: Wedbush kept this gaming stock on its Best Ideas List after its most recent launch
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wedbush analyst Alicia Reese has reiterated an Outperform rating on Take-Two Interactive Software Inc (NASDAQ:TTWO) and raised her price target to $295 from $280, keeping the stock on the firm's Best Ideas List following the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI.
